name: scene-card-studio
title_zh: 一套照片叙事引擎：风格统一、提示词可追溯、版式可编辑
tagline_zh: 给旅行、展览、家藏老照片做风格化组图，不用一张张调。自带版本化提示词和可编辑故事版式，改一张全组跟着变。
tagline_en: Turn travel, archive, or heritage shots into a coherent art-directed series with versioned prompts and editable.
desc_en: Turn one user-supplied photo or a related photo set into art-directed After images, coherent visual narratives, versioned prompts, and editable story layouts. Use for cinematic, memory, archive, editorial, travel, reportage, museum, watercolor, heritage, ink, relief, textile, pixel, risograph, gouache, or 3D treatments.
why_zh: 它把「风格迁移」做成叙事工程：每张成片都带着可回放的提示词版本，组图之间自动对齐视觉语言。
why_en: It treats style transfer as narrative engineering: every output carries replayable prompt versions, and the set stays visually.
limit_zh: 只吃用户自带的照片或相关照片集，不接网络图片；产物是成片+提示词+版式文件，不负责打印、发布或跨集风格融合；水彩。
limit_en: Input: local photos only. Output: images, prompts, and layout files—no printing, publishing, or cross-set style blending. Low-res sources will blur.
title_en: A Photo-to-Narrative Engine: Cohesive Styles, Traceable.
